WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    orderslink,
    AVG(rebtotal) as avg_rebtotal,
    AVG(
      CASE 
        WHEN rebrate IS NOT NULL 
          AND feerate IS NOT NULL 
          AND feerate != 0 
        THEN rebrate / feerate 
        ELSE NULL 
      END
    ) as avg_ratio
  FROM fees
  WHERE rebrate >= 0.0005
  GROUP BY orderslink
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as overall_avg_ratio
  FROM step1
)
SELECT 
  step1.orderslink,
  step1.avg_rebtotal,
  step1.avg_ratio,
  step1.avg_ratio / step2.overall_avg_ratio as division_result
FROM step1
CROSS JOIN step2
WHERE step2.overall_avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY division_result DESC
LIMIT 10
